Score the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB for $500 off, 48GB model for $400 off, and more deals

Aside from the ongoing "July Black Friday" pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and $100 off across all colors of AirPods Max 2, the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup pricing has yet to come back down. Our curated deals include: the 14-inch 24GB/2TB M5 Pro model from Amazon, a straight $500 off MSRP; and the 48GB model from B&H, $400 off the listed price.

This is hands down the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we've seen since the MacBook Pro price hike — Amazon has dropped the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro to $2,499 with free shipping. Originally priced at $2,999, this model with 24GB RAM and 2TB of internal storage is $500 below the new official price.

This deal is especially attractive because Apple just raised the price on this configuration by $400 not long ago, and prior to the price hike, Amazon had never gone below $2,340.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro discounts is B&H's 14-inch 48GB/1TB M5 Pro model at $2,799 with free shipping. While you'll pay more for double the RAM, it's $400 off the $3,199 listed price, and this configuration is completely unavailable on Amazon.

Twelve South PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to $40, new Amazon low

The Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C charger with Apple Find My functionality is now discounted to $40 on Amazon, nearly 45% off the original price.

Amazon is currently selling the Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C wall charger for $39.99 with free shipping.

This product originally launched at $70, and after a price drop, Twelve South's official MSRP is set at $50. Although it has hovered around $55 on Amazon for most of the year, it has now fallen to a new 2026 low. During this year's Prime Day, it dipped to just slightly above $40.

Beyond its unique and minimalist design, this product is essentially a practical everyday carry and travel accessory, offering a relatively slim wall charger with two USB-C ports on the bottom, ready to charge your devices wherever there's an outlet.

Featuring foldable prongs for easy storage and portability, with a maximum output of 50W, the real highlight is the built-in Apple Find My functionality. It works just like other third-party Find My devices, quickly connecting to the Find My app to provide standard location tracking and left-behind notifications — a reassuring feature for a charger, especially when carrying it out and about in your EDC bag.

For an in-depth look at the features and user experience, check out my hands-on review of the Twelve South PlugBug.

Hurry to grab the Apple Watch Series 11 "July Black Friday" deal starting from $299, $100 off before it sells out

Summer still has a long way to go, so if you're looking to pick up a brand new Apple wearable, you'd better act fast while the most popular Series 11 models still have $100 off the listed price.

Over the past week, we've seen plenty of special deals on higher-end Apple Watch Series 11 configurations, but if you're like me and want the most affordable, best-value model, the $100 off basic model is the way to go:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

As of this morning / time of writing, Amazon still has stock of the basic aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models at $100 off. However, we're starting to see some case colors of the larger 46mm model going out of stock, so you may want to keep an eye on the situation to avoid prices going back up.

These deals are largely in line with the best prices we've seen since the product launched, the only exception being June Prime Day, when some models were $20 cheaper than today. However, as the "July Black Friday" deals are expected to wind down by this weekend, these Apple Watch Series 11 discounts may follow suit, and we're already starting to see signs of that.
